gap_fill.rule: A needed neutron nuclide that FENDL-3.2 lacks comes from ENDF/B-VIII.1 and is listed here; nothing is mixed silently.

licence_and_redistribution.endfb_vii1: ENDF/B-VII.1 is published by the NNDC, Brookhaven National Laboratory. The NNDC download page states no explicit licence; redistribution rights remain unresolved, as in docs/PHOTON_LIBRARY_ACQUISITION.md.
licence_and_redistribution.endfb_viii1: ENDF/B-VIII.1 (OpenMC's official HDF5 build) is published by the NNDC and distributed through OpenMC. No licence text was checked for this build; treated as the existing documentation treats NNDC data: local research use, no redistribution.
licence_and_redistribution.established: Byte identity of every file (SHA-256), the NNDC MD5 of the two ENDF/B-VII.1 archives, OpenMC readability (audit), the source of every entry.
licence_and_redistribution.fendl32: FENDL-3.2 is distributed by the IAEA Nuclear Data Section under IAEA NDS terms of use. The terms were not re-read for this build; FARIS keeps the files local and Git-ignored and does not redistribute them.
licence_and_redistribution.not_established: Redistribution rights for any of the data; authentication of the FENDL-3.2 and ENDF/B-VIII.1 HDF5 acquisition (no publisher checksum was available to compare); suitability of any evaluation for a particular calculation.

neutron_data.method: byte-for-byte copy (not symlink, not hard link); SHA-256 of source and copy compared at build time
neutron_data.rule: all FENDL-3.2 neutron nuclides, plus nuclides of the fusion-materials-v1 set that FENDL-3.2 lacks, from ENDF/B-VIII.1

photon_data.converter: openmc.data.IncidentPhoton.from_endf(photoatomic, relaxation); export_to_hdf5(path, mode='w'); re-opened with IncidentPhoton.from_hdf5
photon_data.elements_rule: every element that appears in a neutron nuclide of this library
photon_data.evaluation: ENDF/B-VII.1 photoatomic and atomic relaxation sublibraries (NNDC)

absent_for_fusion_materials.H2O oxygen: ENDF/B-VIII.1 has no O-in-liquid-H2O table; oxygen in light water is free-gas
absent_for_fusion_materials.PbLi, B4C, Li4SiO4, Li2TiO3, Be12Ti: no table in the ENDF/B-VIII.1 set; free-gas treatment
absent_for_fusion_materials.TiH2: no Ti-in-TiH2 or H-in-TiH2 table in ENDF/B-VIII.1
absent_for_fusion_materials.natural Li hydride/deuteride: tables exist for 7LiH and 7LiD only (Li-7 enriched); no natural-lithium table

thermal_scattering_data.assumption: Combining a thermal-scattering library with a neutron evaluation from a different library is standard practice, but it is a stated assumption: the S(alpha,beta) tables were evaluated with ENDF/B-VIII.1 neutron data. Apply a table only when a material declares it.
thermal_scattering_data.evaluation: ENDF/B-VIII.1 thermal scattering (OpenMC HDF5 build), used with FENDL-3.2 neutron data
